<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Careers at EaseMyTrip — Boost Your Professional Journey with India’s Leading Travel Platform</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<script src="https://www.easemytrip.com/offers/anniversary/js/mobjquery.min.js"></script>
<link href="https://www.easemytrip.com/css/nwhomfiles/desktopmenulogin.css?v=9" rel="stylesheet" />
<link href="https://www.easemytrip.com/css/new-login-flow-style.css?v=1" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="https://www.easemytrip.com/css/mobemthome-new.css?v=2.3.1">
<link href="https://www.easemytrip.com/css/nwhomfiles/desktopmenulogin.css?v=9" rel="stylesheet" />	

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
  :root{
    --emt-blue:#2093EF;
    --emt-blue-deep:#0B6FD0;
    --emt-blue-700:#0A56A8;
    --ink:#07294D;
    --ink-2:#0A1F3C;
    --orange:#FF7A1A;
    --orange-deep:#F2620A;
    --sky:#EAF4FE;
    --sky-2:#F3F8FE;
    --cloud:#F5F7FA;
    --paper:#FFFFFF;
    --muted:#5A6B7B;
    --line:#E4EAF1;
    --radius:18px;
    --radius-sm:12px;
    --shadow-sm:0 4px 14px rgba(10,31,60,.06);
    --shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(10,31,60,.22);
    --shadow-lg:0 30px 60px -24px rgba(10,31,60,.35);
    --maxw:1180px;
    --ff:'Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;
    --mono:'DM Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    font-family:var(--ff);
    color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--paper);
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  img{display:block;max-width:100%}
  .container{width:100%;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
  .section{padding:96px 0}
  ::selection{background:var(--emt-blue);color:#fff}

  /* ---------- Eyebrow / headings ---------- */
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--emt-blue);font-weight:500;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:26px;height:2px;background:var(--emt-blue);border-radius:2px}
  h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:700}
  h2.title{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,48px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px}
  h2.title .hl{color:var(--emt-blue)}
  .section-lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;max-width:560px}
  .center{text-align:center}
  .center .section-lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}

  /* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;
    font-family:var(--ff);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;border:none;
    padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,background .18s ease;
  }
  .btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:3px}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--emt-blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 26px -10px rgba(32,147,239,.7)}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--emt-blue-deep);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn-orange{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 26px -10px rgba(255,122,26,.7)}
  .btn-orange:hover{background:var(--orange-deep);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn-outline{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--emt-blue);color:var(--emt-blue);transform:translateY(-2px)}

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:70px}
  .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  .logo .mark{color:var(--ink)}.logo .my{color:var(--emt-blue)}
  .logo svg{width:30px;height:30px}
  .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:34px}
  .nav-links a{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);position:relative;padding:4px 0}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--emt-blue)}
  .nav-links a.active{color:var(--emt-blue)}
  .nav-links a.active::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-4px;width:100%;height:2px;background:var(--emt-blue);border-radius:2px}
  .nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
  .menu-btn span{width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);border-radius:2px}

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{position:relative;background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 78% 20%,#0e3a6b 0%,#0a234a 45%,#071a36 100%);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
  .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
     radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent),
     radial-gradient(2px 2px at 70% 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent),
     radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 40% 80%,rgba(255,255,255,.1),transparent);
     pointer-events:none}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:30px;min-height:600px;padding:54px 0 30px;position:relative;z-index:2}
  .hero .eyebrow{color:#7fc0ff}
  .hero .eyebrow::before{background:#7fc0ff}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,5.2vw,62px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-bottom:22px}
  .hero h1 .yr{color:var(--emt-blue);position:relative;white-space:nowrap}
  .hero p.sub{font-size:18px;color:#c3d6ec;max-width:500px;margin-bottom:34px}
  .hero-actions{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .globe-wrap{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:480px}
  #globe{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:560px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
  #globe:active{cursor:grabbing}
  .globe-glow{position:absolute;width:78%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(32,147,239,.35) 0%,rgba(32,147,239,0) 62%);filter:blur(8px);z-index:0}

  /* hero stats — clean glass card row */
  .hero-stats{position:relative;z-index:2;margin:8px 0 64px;
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    border-radius:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);overflow:hidden}
  .hstat{padding:26px 30px;position:relative}
  .hstat+.hstat::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:22%;height:56%;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
  .hstat .num{font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1}
  .hstat .num .u{color:var(--orange)}
  .hstat .lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#9db8d6;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:10px}

  
.career-visual{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:500px}
.team-image{width:100%;max-width:520px;border-radius:28px;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.floating-card{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 18px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.floating-card span{font-size:24px}
.floating-card strong{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:700}
.floating-card p{margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#d9e8f7}
.card-1{top:40px;right:-20px}
.card-2{bottom:120px;left:-30px}
.card-3{bottom:20px;right:10px}

/* ---------- WHY WORK ---------- */
  .why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:start}
  .why-copy h2{margin-bottom:22px}
  .why-copy p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:18px;font-size:16.5px}
  .why-copy p strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
  .why-media{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;gap:16px}
  .why-media .ph{border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--emt-blue),var(--ink))}
  .why-media .ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
  .why-media .ph.tall{grid-row:span 2;min-height:380px}
  .why-media .ph.short{min-height:182px}
  .quote-badge{grid-column:1 / -1;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 26px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}
  .quote-badge .q{font-size:42px;line-height:.6;color:var(--emt-blue);font-family:Georgia,serif}
  .quote-badge p{color:#cfe0f2;font-size:15px;margin:0}

  /* ---------- WHAT WE OFFER ---------- */
  .offer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}
  .offer-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px 24px;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
  .offer-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:transparent}
  .offer-card .ic{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;background:var(--sky);color:var(--emt-blue)}
  .offer-card:nth-child(2n) .ic{background:#FFF1E6;color:var(--orange)}
  .offer-card .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
  .offer-card h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
  .offer-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}


  /* ---------- OPEN ROLES ---------- */

  /* ---------- OPEN ROLES ---------- */
  .roles-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:30px}
  .roles-tools{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;margin-bottom:30px}
  .search-row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .search-box{flex:1;min-width:240px;position:relative}
  .search-box input{width:100%;padding:14px 16px 14px 46px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-radius:999px;font-family:var(--ff);font-size:15px;background:#1a1f2e;color:#f0f4ff;transition:border-color .18s ease}
  .search-box input::placeholder{color:#4a5568}
  .search-box input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--emt-blue)}
  .search-box svg{position:absolute;left:17px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#4a5568;width:18px;height:18px}
  .chips{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .chip{font-family:var(--ff);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);color:#94a3b8;cursor:pointer;transition:all .16s ease;white-space:nowrap}
  .chip:hover{border-color:var(--emt-blue);color:#60a5fa}
  .chip.active{background:var(--emt-blue);border-color:var(--emt-blue);color:#fff}

  .jobs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}

  /* B2 — slate/charcoal dark cards */
  .job-card{background:#1a1f2e;border-radius:14px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:200px;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)}
  .job-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.14)}

  /* dept badge pill */
  .job-top{margin-bottom:14px}
  .job-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 11px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .job-dept-ic{width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0}
  .job-dept-ic svg{width:14px;height:14px}

  /* badge colors per dept */
  .badge-eng{background:rgba(32,147,239,0.15);color:#60a5fa}
  .badge-prd{background:rgba(139,92,246,0.15);color:#a78bfa}
  .badge-mkt{background:rgba(251,146,60,0.15);color:#fb923c}
  .badge-sal{background:rgba(16,185,129,0.15);color:#34d399}
  .badge-cus{background:rgba(245,158,11,0.15);color:#fbbf24}
  .badge-dat{background:rgba(6,182,212,0.15);color:#22d3ee}
  .badge-fin{background:rgba(132,204,22,0.15);color:#a3e635}
  .badge-hr{background:rgba(236,72,153,0.15);color:#f472b6}
  .badge-ops{background:rgba(239,68,68,0.15);color:#f87171}

  .job-card h3{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.35;color:#f0f4ff}
  .job-meta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#6b7a99;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:auto}
  .job-meta span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
  .job-meta svg{width:13px;height:13px}
  .job-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)}
  .view-desc{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:#60a5fa;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;font-family:var(--ff);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:0}
  .view-desc:hover{color:#93c5fd}
  .view-desc svg{width:14px;height:14px}
  .apply-link{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#fb923c;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
  .apply-link svg{width:14px;height:14px;transition:transform .16s ease}
  .job-card:hover .apply-link svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
  .no-results{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:#94a3b8;padding:40px;font-size:16px}
  .roles-cta{text-align:center;margin-top:40px}

  /* ---------- JD DRAWER ---------- */
  .drawer-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,31,60,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .3s ease,visibility .3s ease;z-index:90}
  .drawer-overlay.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
  .drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:min(560px,92vw);background:#fff;z-index:100;
    transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .36s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:-30px 0 60px -20px rgba(7,31,60,.4)}
  .drawer.open{transform:translateX(0)}
  .drawer-head{padding:26px 30px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink),var(--emt-blue-700));color:#fff;position:relative;flex-shrink:0}
  .drawer-head .dept-pill{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9fd0ff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .drawer-head h3{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.2}
  .drawer-head .dmeta{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13.5px;color:#cfe2f7}
  .drawer-head .dmeta span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .drawer-head .dmeta svg{width:14px;height:14px}
  .drawer-close{position:absolute;top:20px;right:22px;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background .16s ease}
  .drawer-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
  .drawer-close svg{width:18px;height:18px}
  .drawer-body{padding:28px 30px 24px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1}
  .jd-block{margin-bottom:26px}
  .jd-block h4{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
  .jd-block h4::before{content:"";width:4px;height:16px;background:var(--emt-blue);border-radius:3px}
  .jd-block p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}
  .jd-block ul{list-style:none}
  .jd-block li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;margin-bottom:9px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}
  .jd-block li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:9px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange)}
  .jd-block li strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
  .jd-exp{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;background:var(--sky);color:var(--emt-blue-700);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:10px}
  .drawer-foot{padding:18px 30px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);flex-shrink:0;background:#fff}
  .drawer-foot .btn{width:100%}

  /* ---------- LIFE GALLERY ---------- */
  .life-section{background:var(--cloud)}
  .gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-auto-rows:200px;gap:16px;margin-top:46px}
  .gphoto{border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--emt-blue),var(--ink));box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
  .gphoto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s ease}
  .gphoto::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(7,31,60,.72) 0%,rgba(7,31,60,.05) 55%);opacity:.85;transition:opacity .3s ease}
  .gphoto:hover img{transform:scale(1.08)}
  .gphoto:hover::after{opacity:1}
  .gcap{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:16px;z-index:2;color:#fff;transform:translateY(6px);opacity:0;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease}
  .gphoto:hover .gcap{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}
  .gcap .t{font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
  .gcap .s{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#bcd9f7;text-transform:uppercase}
  .gphoto.w2{grid-column:span 2}
  .gphoto.h2{grid-row:span 2}
  .life-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
  .life-tags .tg{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--emt-blue-700);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 15px;border-radius:999px}
  .life-tags .tg b{color:var(--orange)}

  /* ---------- HIRING JOURNEY ---------- */
  .journey-section{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .journey-section .eyebrow{color:#7fc0ff}.journey-section .eyebrow::before{background:#7fc0ff}
  .journey-section h2.title{color:#fff}
  .journey-section .section-lead{color:#bcd1ea}
  .journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;margin-top:54px;position:relative}
  .jstep{position:relative;padding:0 22px;text-align:center}
  .jline{position:absolute;top:27px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(127,192,255,.35),transparent);z-index:0}
  .jdot{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:#0d2c54;border:2px solid var(--emt-blue);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 20px;position:relative;z-index:1;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;font-weight:500}
  .jstep:nth-child(3) .jdot,.jstep:nth-child(5) .jdot{border-color:var(--orange)}
  .jstep h4{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}
  .jstep p{color:#a9c2de;font-size:14px}

  /* ---------- BOTTOM CTA ---------- */
  .endcta{padding:96px 0 100px;background:var(--paper)}
  .endcta-inner{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(115deg,var(--emt-blue) 0%,var(--emt-blue-deep) 58%,var(--emt-blue-700) 130%);border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;padding:60px 56px;color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
  .endcta-inner::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
     radial-gradient(2px 2px at 30% 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.25),transparent),
     radial-gradient(2px 2px at 80% 60%,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent),
     radial-gradient(600px 300px at 90% 110%,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);pointer-events:none}
  .endcta h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,42px);font-weight:800;max-width:560px;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative}
  .endcta p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);max-width:520px;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:30px;position:relative}
  .endcta .btn{position:relative}
  .plane-deco{position:absolute;right:54px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(8deg);opacity:.18;pointer-events:none}
  .plane-deco svg{width:300px;height:300px}

  /* ---------- CONTACT BAND (not a footer) ---------- */

/* =========================================================
   INTERACTIVE WORLD GLOBE  (vanilla canvas, no libraries)
   - REAL geography from an embedded land bitmap (Natural Earth 110m)
   - lat/long graticule, country-to-country flight arcs, city lights
   - DRAG with cursor / touch to spin it in place
   ========================================================= */
(function(){
  const canvas=document.getElementById('globe');
  if(!canvas)return;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  const reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  let DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  let size=560,R=0,cx=0,cy=0;
  function resize(){
    const cssW=Math.min(canvas.parentElement.clientWidth||560,560);
    size=cssW;canvas.style.width=size+'px';canvas.style.height=size+'px';
    canvas.width=size*DPR;canvas.height=size*DPR;ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
    R=size*0.40;cx=size/2;cy=size/2;
  }
  resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

  // ---- embedded land mask (bit-packed, MSB-first, row-major) ----
  const MW=720,MH=360;
  const MASK_B64="";
  const bin=atob(MASK_B64);
  function bit(idx){return (bin.charCodeAt(idx>>3)>>(7-(idx&7)))&1;}
  function isLand(lng,lat){
    let ix=((lng+180)/360*MW)|0; ix=((ix%MW)+MW)%MW;
    let iy=((90-lat)/180*MH)|0; if(iy<0)iy=0; if(iy>=MH)iy=MH-1;
    return bit(iy*MW+ix);
  }
  function ll(lat,lng){const phi=(90-lat)*Math.PI/180,th=(lng+180)*Math.PI/180;
    return [-Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(th),Math.cos(phi),Math.sin(phi)*Math.sin(th)];}

  // ---- build land dot cloud once (accurate continents) ----
  const N=18000,gold=Math.PI*(3-Math.sqrt(5)),land=[];
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const y=1-(i/(N-1))*2,r=Math.sqrt(1-y*y),th=gold*i;
    const x=Math.cos(th)*r,z=Math.sin(th)*r;
    const lat=Math.asin(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,y)))*180/Math.PI;
    const lng=Math.atan2(z,x)*180/Math.PI;
    if(isLand(lng,lat))land.push([x,y,z]);
  }

  // ---- graticule (lat/long grid) ----
  const grid=[];
  for(let la=-60;la<=60;la+=30){const l=[];for(let lo=-180;lo<=180;lo+=4)l.push(ll(la,lo));grid.push(l);}
  for(let lo=-180;lo<180;lo+=30){const l=[];for(let la=-85;la<=85;la+=4)l.push(ll(la,lo));grid.push(l);}

  // ---- cities + routes (real cities -> arcs end on land) ----
  const C={delhi:ll(28.6,77.2),mumbai:ll(19,72.8),dubai:ll(25.2,55.3),london:ll(51.5,-0.1),
    paris:ll(48.8,2.3),newyork:ll(40.7,-74),singapore:ll(1.3,103.8),bangkok:ll(13.7,100.5),
    hongkong:ll(22.3,114.2),sydney:ll(-33.8,151.2),nairobi:ll(-1.3,36.8),tokyo:ll(35.6,139.7),
    istanbul:ll(41,28.9),capetown:ll(-33.9,18.4),saopaulo:ll(-23.5,-46.6)};
  const ROUTES=[['delhi','dubai'],['delhi','london'],['mumbai','singapore'],['delhi','newyork'],
    ['bangkok','hongkong'],['mumbai','nairobi'],['delhi','sydney'],['london','newyork'],
    ['dubai','paris'],['singapore','tokyo'],['delhi','istanbul'],['nairobi','capetown'],['london','saopaulo']];
  // ---- rotation state + drag (works anywhere inside globe circle) ----
  let rotY=-1.5,tiltX=-0.28,vel=0,dragging=false,lastX=0,lastY=0;
  function insideGlobe(e){
    const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mx=(e.clientX-rect.left)*(canvas.width/DPR/rect.width);
    const my=(e.clientY-rect.top)*(canvas.height/DPR/rect.height);
    const dx=mx-cx,dy=my-cy;
    return Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<=R*1.08;
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    dragging=true;lastX=e.clientX;lastY=e.clientY;
    try{canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_){}
    e.preventDefault();
  },{passive:false});
  window.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!dragging)return;
    const dx=e.clientX-lastX,dy=e.clientY-lastY;
    rotY+=dx*0.006;tiltX=Math.max(-1.1,Math.min(1.1,tiltX+dy*0.005));
    vel=dx*0.006;lastX=e.clientX;lastY=e.clientY;});
  window.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{dragging=false;});
  window.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{dragging=false;});

  function rot(p){const x=p[0],y=p[1],z=p[2],c=Math.cos(rotY),s=Math.sin(rotY);
    const x1=x*c+z*s,z1=-x*s+z*c,c2=Math.cos(tiltX),s2=Math.sin(tiltX);
    return [x1,y*c2-z1*s2,y*s2+z1*c2];}
  function slerp(a,b,t){let d=a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2];d=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,d));
    const om=Math.acos(d);if(om<1e-4)return a.slice();const so=Math.sin(om),k1=Math.sin((1-t)*om)/so,k2=Math.sin(t*om)/so;
    return [a[0]*k1+b[0]*k2,a[1]*k1+b[1]*k2,a[2]*k1+b[2]*k2];}
  function strokeLine(pts,color,w){ctx.beginPath();ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=w;let pen=false;
    for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){const p=rot(pts[i]);if(p[2]<-0.02){pen=false;continue;}
      const sx=cx+p[0]*R,sy=cy-p[1]*R;if(!pen){ctx.moveTo(sx,sy);pen=true;}else ctx.lineTo(sx,sy);}
    ctx.stroke();}

  let t0=performance.now();
  function frame(now){
    const dt=(now-t0)/1000;t0=now;
    if(!dragging){if(Math.abs(vel)>0.0009){rotY+=vel;vel*=0.94;}else if(!reduce){rotY+=dt*0.07;}}
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,size,size);

    // sphere body — no outer glow ring
    const body=ctx.createRadialGradient(cx-R*0.32,cy-R*0.32,R*0.1,cx,cy,R);
    body.addColorStop(0,'rgba(18,66,124,0.50)');body.addColorStop(1,'rgba(6,20,46,0.85)');

    for(let i=0;i<land.length;i++){const p=rot(land[i]);if(p[2]<-0.03)continue;
      const d=(p[2]+1)/2,sx=cx+p[0]*R,sy=cy-p[1]*R,s=0.8+d*1.6;
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba('+Math.round(165+d*75)+','+Math.round(208+d*42)+',255,'+(0.38+d*0.56)+')';
      ctx.fillRect(sx-s/2,sy-s/2,s,s);}

    // flight arcs — full great-circle line city→city, comet travels the whole arc
    const period=5.8,segs=72;
    ROUTES.forEach(function(rt,idx){
      const a=C[rt[0]],b=C[rt[1]],phase=((now/1000)/period+idx/ROUTES.length)%1;
      const pts=[];
      for(let s=0;s<=segs;s++){
        const tt=s/segs,bs=slerp(a,b,tt),lift=1+0.22*Math.sin(Math.PI*tt);
        pts.push([bs[0]*lift,bs[1]*lift,bs[2]*lift]);
      }
      // full arc line (city to city, over ocean too — just like real flight paths)
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(115,195,255,0.32)';ctx.lineWidth=1;let pen=false;
      for(let s=0;s<=segs;s++){
        const p=rot(pts[s]);if(p[2]<-0.04){pen=false;continue;}
        const sx=cx+p[0]*R,sy=cy-p[1]*R;
        if(!pen){ctx.moveTo(sx,sy);pen=true;}else ctx.lineTo(sx,sy);
      }ctx.stroke();
      // comet head travels full arc
      for(let s=0;s<=segs;s++){
        const p=rot(pts[s]);if(p[2]<-0.04)continue;
        const sx=cx+p[0]*R,sy=cy-p[1]*R,d=(p[2]+1)/2;
        const tt=s/segs;let dd=Math.abs(tt-phase);dd=Math.min(dd,1-dd);
        const head=Math.max(0,1-dd*8);
        if(head<=0.06)continue;
        // bright white-blue comet core
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,242,255,'+(head*d)+')';
        ctx.arc(sx,sy,0.6+head*2.2,0,7);ctx.fill();
        // soft outer glow
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(140,210,255,'+(head*0.4*d)+')';
        ctx.arc(sx,sy,1.2+head*4,0,7);ctx.fill();
      }
    });

    // city lights — only verified land coordinates (all cross-checked against isLand)
    const LAND_LIGHTS=[
      [28.6,77.2],[17.5,73.5],[12.9,77.6],[22.5,88.3],[51.5,-0.1],[48.8,2.3],
      [52.5,13.4],[41.9,12.5],[40.7,-74],[34,-118.2],[19.4,-99.1],[-23.5,-46.6],
      [25.2,55.3],[-0.2,102.3],[13.7,100.5],[35.6,139.7],[31.2,121.5],[39.9,116.4],
      [22.1,112.7],[-33.8,151.2],[55.7,37.6],[41,28.9],[-1.3,36.8],[-25.7,28.2],
      [30.1,31.2],[6.5,3.4],[14.7,-17.4],[-4.3,15.3],[33.9,-6.9],[36.8,10.2],
      [23.7,90.4],[17.4,78.5],[13,77.6]
    ].filter(c=>isLand(c[1],c[0])).map(c=>ll(c[0],c[1]));

    // draw city lights (all verified land-only)
    for(let i=0;i<LAND_LIGHTS.length;i++){const p=rot(LAND_LIGHTS[i]);if(p[2]<0.02)continue;
      const d=(p[2]+1)/2,sx=cx+p[0]*R,sy=cy-p[1]*R;
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(205,238,255,'+(0.6*d)+')';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,1.1+d*0.5,0,7);ctx.fill();}
    const pulse=(Math.sin(now/460)+1)/2;
    for(const k in C){const p=rot(C[k]);if(p[2]<0.03)continue;
      const sx=cx+p[0]*R,sy=cy-p[1]*R,d=(p[2]+1)/2;
      const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,0,sx,sy,7+pulse*5);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,210,255,'+(0.5*d)+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,210,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,7+pulse*5,0,7);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(210,240,255,'+d+')';ctx.arc(sx,sy,1.9,0,7);ctx.fill();}

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
